answer: New participants must deposit collateral that is slashed if collusion is detected, and voting weight flows along a single river of staked history rather than raw wallet count, so a sybil swarm must lock real capital per fake identity and risks losing it all, making attacks economically irrational. Agents earn trust by staking tokens tied to a verifiable reputation slot, and each identity's influence decays if it lets its reputation wander into a nadir of inactivity. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
